videos.description: Palm Beach Pete really proved that you don’t need Hollywood… you just need a character and a camera. 🌴 From cruising around Palm Beach in loud fits to turning everyday luxury spots into a stage, Pete leaned all the way into the persona. Some say he’s trolling. Some say he’s branding. But the internet did what it does best — it amplified him. In 2026, virality isn’t about being perfect. It’s about being unforgettable. So tell me… mastermind or meme? 👇 #PalmBeachPete #ForYou #FYP #ViralTok #InternetCharacter
